description: This file provides utility functions for string manipulation, including splitting strings at specified ranges, searching for a query within a string, and splitting a string based on a query's occurrence.

methods.name: splitRangeWithinString
methods.description: Splits a string into parts at specified start and end indices, with checks for out of bounds and invalid ranges.

methods.name: getIndexOfQueryInString
methods.description: Finds the starting index of a query string within a larger string, case-insensitive.

methods.name: splitQueryInString
methods.description: Splits a string into three parts: before the query, the query, and after the query, based on the first occurrence of the query.
